channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Aurora selects final site for its largest reservoir yet in Park County. Will it fill up?
item.description: The proposed Wild Horse Reservoir is set for a site near Spinney Mountain Reservoir in Park County near the town of Hartsel.

item.title: Gunnison Valley community rallies behind family after 7-year-old boy attacked, killed by dog
item.description: The Feb. 4 attack has left a tight-knit Western Slope community reeling. Police remain tight-lipped as the investigation continues.

item.title: Colorado law prohibits candidates from running for two elected offices at the same time. Sort of.
item.description: Candidates sometimes simultaneously maintain campaign accounts for state and federal office, or state and municipal office, when their pursuit of those jobs overlaps. Technically, they are running for two positions at once. Practically, they are not, and state elections officials don’t treat it as a violation of the law.

item.title: The Michelin Guide expands to cover all of Colorado in 2026
item.description: The premier restaurant guide landed in Colorado in 2023 to focus on four major culinary scenes. This year, the anonymous agents will scour the whole state.

item.title: Colorado required to share personal Medicaid data with federal government, which can be used by immigration authorities
item.description: Denver Health told Medicaid patients that “limited” personal information could be shared with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Opinion: I was a CDC vaccine adviser. Here’s why Colorado needs to act on its own vaccination guidelines.
item.description: With federal government changing recommendations, Colorado legislation would bring stability, clarity and a firm commitment to science

item.title: Workers at JBS plant in Greeley prepare to launch nation’s first meatpacker strike in decades
item.description: The union is protesting unsafe working conditions and an expired contract, while also supporting Haitian immigrants who could lose TPS status

item.title: As some Democratic governors lead on ICE pushback, Jared Polis is taking a hands-off approach
item.description: Colorado's leader has asked for more federal accountability, but so far hasn't signaled he's on board with legislative efforts to further rein in ICE

item.title: All of the reasons Colorado’s horrible snowpack is so problematic
item.description: This week’s snowstorms in parts of Colorado won’t do enough to make up for a deep, statewide snow drought, experts say. And everything from pikas to farmers are feeling the impacts.

item.title: Federal judge stops Trump plans to cut public health funding to Colorado, other Democratic-led states
item.description: The federal government had planned to cut grants that funded HIV prevention work and sexually transmitted disease surveillance in Colorado
